# Soundness Requirements Checklist: HEX-C2-02 Wrapped Intervals, Congruence, and Branch Refinement

**Purpose**: Review whether HEX-C2-02 requirements are complete, unambiguous, measurable, and release-ready across abstract-domain, branch, identity, resource, and ownership boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-08-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Abstract-Domain Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the specification define wrapped interval, empty, full, known-bit, and congruence representations for every supported width without leaving normalization implicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are join and widening requirements explicit about over-approximation, monotonicity, and deterministic termination when product-domain components disagree? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Are signed/unsigned interpretation, modular wrap, width conversion, mask, and shift boundaries all stated as acceptance requirements rather than implementation assumptions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007–FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec explicitly prevent any non-singleton interval, residue, or known-bit pattern from becoming an exact constant? [Soundness, Spec §Conservative Boundary]

## Branch and Path Refinement

- [ ] CHK005 Are equality, inequality, signed ordering, unsigned ordering, and bound refinements specified for both true and false edges? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Is edge/block-entry ownership unambiguous, including the prohibition on mutating global value truth with a path-specific fact? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Are mask-derived congruence, switch case/default, contradictory predicates, and mathematically impossible branches bounded by explicit evidence conditions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010–FR-011; §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Are phi joins, loop widening, pointer offsets, and alignment facts required to retain provenance and conservative behavior at merges? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012–FR-013]

## Evidence and Lifecycle

- [ ] CHK009 Are CFG/SSA/pass-registry/semantic identities and source origins named as freshness dependencies for global and edge facts? [Completeness, Spec §IDENTITY_SOURCE, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK010 Are complete, partial, unknown, cancelled, unsupported, malformed, stale, and budget-limited outcomes distinct and non-promotable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §Conservative Boundary]
- [ ] CHK011 Are atomic publication, versioning, invalidation, and prior-state retention requirements consistent for failed or incomplete runs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK012 Are deterministic replay and downstream proof requirements measurable without using timing or self-agreement as semantic evidence? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018, §SC-004, §SC-006]

## Test and Boundary Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Does the required proof matrix enumerate wrap, extrema, signedness, comparison, switch, phi, loop, budget, mask/shift, alignment, pointer, impossible-branch, stale, cancellation, malformed, and replay cases? [Coverage, Spec §Required Proof Matrix, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK014 Are paired negative cases defined for every precision-positive case, including unknown predicate, non-constant mask, incomplete switch, pointer provenance absence, and non-converged loop? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the downstream precision-improvement requirement bounded so a test-only or projection-only change cannot satisfy it without canonical fact consumption? [Traceability, Spec §FR-017, §FR-020, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the specification preserve existing test denominators, generated-output ownership, exact-head evidence, candidate-tree proof, and post-merge verification? [Release, Spec §SC-001, §SC-007; §Assumptions]

## Ownership and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK017 Is the single canonical owner (`range.js` domain plus `sccp.js` producer) distinguished from direct and downstream consumers? [Ownership, Spec §CANONICAL_OWNER, §DIRECT_CONSUMERS]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the plan need to state `SECOND_SEMANTIC_TRUTH_CREATED: NO` and forbid private solver, MemorySSA, ABI, type, and pointer engines? [Consistency, Spec §SECOND_SEMANTIC_TRUTH_CREATED, §Non-Goals]
- [ ] CHK019 Are C2-01 and C3-02 dependencies limited to declared interfaces and post-reconciliation retesting, with no accidental source/test overlap accepted? [Dependency, Spec §Non-Goals, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Is generated userscript output explicitly integration-owned and excluded from this component lane’s committed files? [Ownership, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
